# API reference

Generated 2026-09-28 from the FastAPI application itself: **74 paths**, **77 operations**.

Interactive documentation: [Swagger UI](/docs) and [ReDoc](/redoc); the machine-readable schema is at [/openapi.json](/openapi.json).

## Conventions used by every endpoint

* `x-session-id` header isolates files, analyses, reports and generated signals per browser session.
* Long-running work (`POST /api/analyze`, `POST /api/blind-analysis`, `POST /api/benchmark`) returns a job immediately; poll `GET /api/jobs/{job_id}` for `progress`/`stage_message` and `DELETE`/`POST /api/jobs/{job_id}/cancel` to abort.
* Measured quantities are returned as `{value, unit, confidence, method, evidence, status}`. When an estimator cannot support a number it returns `status="unable"` with `value=null` and a reason - the platform never invents a parameter.
* Modulation, FEC, interleaving and protocol statements are **hypotheses**: ranked candidates, confidence, evidence and an explicit limitations list.
